name: city-budget-footnotes-in-body-paragraphs-v1
description: Two body paragraphs each contain multiple footnote references inline, requiring the converter to preserve several distinct notes attached to ordinary prose.

runs.text: The finance office reported that transit ridership recovered to 92% of pre-2020 levels
runs.footnote: Ridership estimate is based on fare-gate counts from January through September.

runs.text: , while fuel costs for the municipal fleet rose by 14% year over year
runs.footnote: Fuel costs reflect blended diesel and gasoline purchasing contracts.

runs.text: Council also approved a reserve transfer of $3.5 million
runs.footnote: The transfer comes from the capital stabilization reserve.

runs.text: to cover storm drain repairs identified after the spring audit
runs.footnote: The audit reviewed 118 drain segments across three districts.

runs.text: , but deferred sidewalk lighting upgrades until next quarter
runs.footnote: Lighting upgrades were postponed pending revised contractor bids.
